v0.5.0.description: First public release. Should be playable from start to finish.
v0.5.0.title: Version 0.5.0

v0.5.1.description:
Changelog:
- Fixed Free Fire Zone artillery returning during story missions.
- Fixed an invisible barrier blocking Mount Vogel.
- Added high- and medium-importance destruction targets as checks, gated by sector unlocks.
- Unlocked sectors now reveal their activities and destruction targets.
- Updated map labels to match Archipelago check names.
- Fixed and resized the story mission tracker; it now appears on the map.
- Added a yaml option to show the reward item in shopsanity purchase descriptions.
- Added crash logging, clearer connection errors, and a /diagnose client command.
v0.5.1.title: Version 0.5.1

v0.6.0.description:
Changelog:
- Added a garage system in every safehouse for spawning vehicles
- Vehicles are now 28 different main unlocks. Styles can be swapped with left and right
- Added check options for 300 ore deposits, 54 billboards, 36 radio tags and 419 supply crates
- Added five additional ammo upgrades for each weapon. These come after the regular upgrades and give increased max ammo
- Added five progressive upgrades to both backpack recharge rate and backpack power
- Filler salvage is now separated into 50, 200 and 400 salvage
- Fixed access to Marauder temple
v0.6.0.title: Version 0.6.0

v0.6.1.description:
Changelog:
- Updated progressive max ammo to work as intended
- Updated progressive backpack strength and recharge to work as intended
- Updated garage spawn locations for larger vehicles
v0.6.1.title: Version 0.6.1

v0.6.2.description:
Changelog:
- Added functional gunships and configurable unlock/purchase options
- Added optional salvage costs for spawning vehicles
- Added a fog toggle by pressing F8
- Salvage filler items now scale based on total checks
- Fixed and tweaked different minor issues
v0.6.2.title: Version 0.6.2
